episodes.title: The Yankee Dodge
episodes.summary: With a huge gambling debt, coinciding with the return of Fagin, Dodger agrees to a final sting.

episodes.title: Blessings of St. Coccyx
episodes.summary: Trying to steal 500 sovereigns, Dodger and Fagin witness Darius in a compromising position.

episodes.title: Dead Men's Secrets
episodes.summary: With Gaines planning their demise, the pressure is on Dodger and Fagin to find the missing money.

episodes.title: The Stitch Up
episodes.summary: Fagin serves up Gaines' wife and Darius. Sneed attacks Dodger at the Governor's dinner.

episodes.title: The Duel
episodes.summary: Fagin plots to swap a valuable barrel with a fake. Sneed and Dodger's rivalry culminates in a duel.

episodes.title: Bully in the Alley
episodes.summary: Gaines plans to rid the colony of crime. Red is captured and must undergo emergency surgery.

episodes.title: Wet Lettuce
episodes.summary: Fagin and Dodger attempt a risky heist in pursuit of gold. Belle reveals her secret to Jack.

episodes.title: Untapped Potential
episodes.summary: Jack attempts to save Belle but is betrayed and arrested by Gaines.

episodes.title: Hangman
episodes.summary: Jack has a date with the noose. Will Belle and Fagin be able to help our hero dodge his fate?

episodes.title: Entry Level Toff
episodes.summary: Belle and Jack find themselves up to their elbows in blood and trouble.

episodes.title: Belle of the Ball
episodes.summary: As Boxer closes in, Jack gatecrashes the masquerade ball to steal a dance with Lady Belle.

episodes.title: Platinum
episodes.summary: Belle finds herself out of her depth while Fagin and Dodger plot to steal something priceless.

episodes.title: Ice Melts
episodes.summary: Belle and Jack's secretive romance comes under threat and Fagin's enemy prepares to strike.

episodes.title: Bellybutton
episodes.summary: A revelation threatens Belle and Jack's romance, before a strange surgery forces them together.

episodes.title: Salt Peter
episodes.summary: An explosive scheme is hatched, Belle and Jack race against time to find a cure for cholera.

episodes.title: Change of Heart
episodes.summary: Lady Jane's secret shocks Belle to her core, Fagin considers a drastic way out of his predicament.
